Cannot issue commission:
(a)
To protect some person
(अ) उद्दाषस्घ अम्द्लहु
To audit the accounts
(M) To divide

for the execution of a decree

A: (d) Under Section 75 of the Code of Civil Procedure 1908
The court can issue a summons in the following cases:
1. To protect a person,
2. For local exploration,
3. For audit of accounts,
4. To divide,
5. To carry out scientific, technical or special investigations,
6. For sale of short-lived assets,
7. To do any disciplinary work.
Therefore, under this section, a commission for execution of a court decree
Can't continue.
